messages:
Avery: Heads-up — I'll be in the office next Thurs for a weird little holiday thing: hammock photos (yes, the hammock in the lounge). Bringing single-serving mulled cider to share. Anyone want to swap small treats? :tropical_drink: 
Diego: 100% yes. I will bring orange-ginger cookies. Sign me up for hammock photo ops. :cookie:
Priya: Ooh cookies. I can bring spiced apple sachets (non-alc). Also, can we do a super quick 10-min 'New Year wish' camera roll around 3pm?
Lila: Count me in. Quick poll — in-office mini gathering at 3pm or 4pm? React with :one: for 3pm, :two: for 4pm.
InfraBot: Reminder: building closes at 6pm on Friday; ensure guests are cleared by security. (automated notice)
Diego: :one:
Avery: :one:
Priya: :two: (I have a 3:30 call that might run)
Lila: :one: (but flexible)
Sam: new-ish person here — saw the hammock pics 😂 can I bring my ukulele for background jingles? :guitar:
Avery: yes please, Sam! 2 songs max so we don't turn into a concert :)
Diego: also heads-up about Secret Santa desk gifts — if it's breakable, please mark as fragile. last year the ceramic gnome did not survive. :crying_cat_face:
Priya: tiny-gnome memorial noted :pray:
InfraBot: Event RSVP updated: Avery, Diego, Priya, Lila, Sam. Guest count: 1 (Avery).
Lila: logistics: can someone grab extra folding chairs from the 4th floor? I'll bring cups and napkins.
Avery: I'll bring two collapsible chairs.
Diego: optional ugly holiday sunhat contest? wearable photos encouraged. :sunglasses:
Sam: sold. see you all — bringing cookies taste-test kit.
Avery: perfect. I'll post a quick calendar invite and a photo thread after. Feel free to drop any dietary notes here. Happy almost-holiday folks! :sparkles:
